name: Todd Blanche
description: Follow Todd Blanche, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump appeals ruling that found his $10B IRS suit aimed to ‘manipulate’ legal proceedings
changes.summary: The case is at the center of negotiations between two Republican senators and the Justice Department over Todd Blanche’s nomination to serve as attorney general.

changes.title: Trump says he may pull Todd Blanche's nomination to circumvent GOP holdouts
changes.summary: President Trump says he's willing to hold his nomination of Attorney General Todd Blanche until January, when he says he'll have an easier political calculation in the Senate.

changes.title: Todd Blanche’s Loyalty to Trump Is Putting His Attorney General Confirmation at Risk
changes.summary: Todd Blanche’s approach has collided with the jury-of-two reality in the Senate that has, thus far, kept him from the prize he covets: the stability and status conferred by a Senate confirmation.

changes.title: In Rush to Track Down Air Force One Leaks, DOJ Reversed Its Own Process
changes.summary: A judge’s remarks on subpoenas to reporters cast attention on two administration officials under consideration for powerful cabinet posts, Todd Blanche and Jay Clayton.

changes.title: Week in Politics: Trump's speech; midterm elections; Todd Blanche and Jay Clayton
changes.summary: Three months from the November midterms, President Trump is drawing attention to issues that are not top priorities for voters.

changes.title: Blanche holds meeting with Epstein accusers after Tillis' request
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche met with accusers of Jeffrey Epstein following a demand to do so by a Republican senator whose support is crucial to advancing his nomination to lead the Justice Department.

changes.title: Schiff presses Ashcroft over Trump's calls for prosecution of perceived political enemies
changes.summary: Sen. Adam Schiff questioned former Attorney General John Ashcroft Thursday about President Trump's calls to prosecute his perceived political enemies. Ashcroft was appearing before the Senate in support of Todd Blanche's confirmation as attorney general.

changes.title: Key takeaways from day two of Blanche confirmation hearing
changes.summary: CBS News senior justice department reporter Sarah Lynch breaks down the highlights from day two of Todd Blanche's Senate confirmation hearings for attorney general.

changes.title: Tillis says he won't support Blanche unless he meets with Epstein survivors
changes.summary: Sen. Thom Tillis said that Todd Blanche must meet with survivors of convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein's crimes before he'll vote to advance his nomination for attorney general out of the Senate Judiciary Committee.
